name: Frank Ocean
description:
'''Frank Ocean''' (born '''Christopher Edwin Breaux''', October 28, 1987) is an American singer and songwriter. [[List of awards and nominations received by Frank Ocean|His accolades]] include two [[Grammy Awards]] and a [[Brit Awards|Brit Award]]. He has been credited by several [[Music journalism|music critics]] as a pioneer of the [[alternative R&B]] genre.

Ocean began his musical career as a [[ghostwriter]] before joining the Los Angeles-based [[Hip hop music|hip hop]] collective [[Odd Future]] in 2010. The year prior, he signed with [[RedZone Entertainment]], an imprint of [[Def Jam Recordings]], although his debut [[mixtape]], ''[[Nostalgia, Ultra]]'' (2011), was released [[Independent music|independently]]. His debut [[studio album]], ''[[Channel Orange]]'' (2012) won [[Grammy Award for Best Urban Contemporary Album|Best Urban Contemporary Album]]; its lead single, "[[Thinkin Bout You (Frank Ocean song)|Thinkin Bout You]]", was nominated for [[Grammy Award for Record of the Year|Record of the Year]]. He was named by ''[[Time (magazine)|Time]]'' as one of the world's [[Time 100|100 most influential people]] in 2013.

After a four-year hiatus, Ocean released the [[visual album]] ''[[Endless (Frank Ocean album)|Endless]]'' (2016) to fulfill contractual obligations with Def Jam. His second studio album, ''[[Blonde (Frank Ocean album)|Blonde]]'', was released independently the following day. ''Blonde'' was met with critical praise, and debuted atop the US [[Billboard 200|''Billboard'' 200]]. After 2017, Ocean has released sporadic singles, worked as a photographer for magazines, launched the fashion brand [[Homer (brand)|Homer]], and started ''Homer Radio''. Ocean has sold over 2 million albums worldwide.
